chunks: Tell them: "You may spend (in the way of God), whether willingly or with reluctance, it will not be accepted from you, for you are reprobates."

key_terms.فَاسِقِينَ: Reprobates or those who transgress divine bounds

ai.seo_question: Why was the spending of the hypocrites not accepted by God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific context of the hypocrites during the Prophet's time, emphasizing that external acts of worship like charity (Sadaqah) are void without internal sincerity (Ikhlas). It underscores the principle that God accepts only from the righteous (Al-Muttaqin), rejecting deeds performed by those whose hearts are disconnected from divine will, whether they act out of genuine desire or mere compulsion.
